scientific_answer_battery.intent: Evaluate whether an agent can prospectively plan an MD study, obtain runner-certified confirmatory MD, and derive the task-owned deterministic conclusion from evaluator-recomputed evidence before comparison with held-out experimental truth. Structural sources and sampling remain agent-selected.

notes: Study-level suite in the MDAgentBench benchmark family.
Tasks focus on open-planning scientific question answering and auditable study bundles, not system preparation alone.
The v0.4 S01 pilot reports three non-compensating gates: valid_execution, claim_supported, and truth_agreement. grounded_correct@1 is their conjunction.
S01 is non-primary while the runner-owned OpenMM adapter and blind feasibility are calibrated.
S02-S04 remain available in an extended experimental tier while their thermodynamic estimands and native free-energy verification contracts are recalibrated.
Preparation-only workflow tasks live in MDPrepBench.

pilot.intent: Establish and calibrate the shared three-gate evaluation contract before any task enters a primary leaderboard.

extended.intent: Research tasks retained for migration and calibration; they are excluded from the primary leaderboard until task-specific thermodynamic evidence is independently recomputable and feasible within budget.
